description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier to change the cursor to a pointing hand when hovering over a SwiftUI view, and also extends the View protocol to include a convenient modifier for this behavior.

classes.name: PointingHandCursorModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that changes the cursor to a pointing hand when the associated view is hovered over.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the view hierarchy that modifies cursor appearance on hover.

methods.name: pointingHandCursor
methods.description: An extension method on View to easily apply the PointingHandCursorModifier.
